production.note: US model years. First: BMW NA says the cars "will begin sales as 2015 models in early Summer, 2014". Last: the 2020 end year rests only on Cars.com, a database, which lists a 2020 BMW M4 in Coupe, Convertible and CS Coupe trims with the Coupe at "425.0-hp, 3.0-liter, Straight 6 Cylinder Engine" (carscom-2020-m4-specs; the same listing also mislists the CS at 425 hp, so it is not fully reliable), and on the G82 M4 starting with the 2021 model year (existing record bmw-m4-g82). No opened BMW page says 2020 was the last model year.

body.note: BMW NA: "The 2015 BMW M4 Convertible" (internally F83), which "arrives in US showrooms late this summer" with the same 425 hp engine; the coupe sheet gives 'No of Doors / Seats 2 / 4'. The convertible is not sold under its own name, so it shares this record. The M4 GTS and M4 CS are separate variants.

aspiration.note: M TwinPower Turbo with two mono-scroll turbochargers, per BMW NA's release

drivetrain.note: Rear-wheel drive with Active M Differential

transmission.note: Standard 6-speed manual, optional "7-speed M Double Clutch Transmission" (M DCT). The 2015 sheet's header reads "Transmission type DKG 7 manual transmission 6".

powerHp.note: Quote: "Engine power / at rpm bHP / 1/min 425 / 5500-7300 425 / 5500-7300" (2015 BMW M4 Coupe, DKG 7 and manual columns). Release: "425 horsepower from 5,500 – 7,300 rpm". BMW NA's 2018 M4 Coupe sheet still gives "hp@rpm 425@5500-7300 425@5500-7300 493@6250" (columns M4 Coupe manual, M4 Coupe DCT, M4 GTS; bmw-us-2018-m4-techdata). The optional Competition Package (a package, not a separate model) gave 444 hp, per BMW NA's MY18 pricing guide ("444hp, new settings for suspension, DSC and Active M Differential"; bmw-us-2018-m4-pricing).

weightLb.note: 2015 M4 Coupe with the 6-speed manual. Quote: "Curb weight (US) Kg / lbs 1626 / 3585 1601 / 3530" (first column DKG 7, second column manual, per the header "Transmission type DKG 7 manual transmission 6"). BMW NA's 2018 sheet gives "lbs 3625 3685 3610" (M4 Coupe manual, M4 Coupe DCT, M4 GTS; bmw-us-2018-m4-techdata). The 2015 M4 Convertible is quoted at "curb weight of just 4,055 lbs" (bmw-us-2014-m4-convertible-release).

discrepancies.reason: Model year. Both are BMW NA curb weights for the manual M4 Coupe: 3,530 lb on the 2015 sheet, 3,625 lb on the 2018 sheet.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 3,530 lb because the reference model year is 2015.

reviewNotes: The 2020 end year rests on Cars.com (a database that also mislists the M4 CS at 425 hp) and the G82 M4 starting in 2021; confirm with a BMW NA 2020 M4 technical data sheet or pricing release.
